runtime.select: All 19 canonical application tables plus upms_production_migrations
runtime.sessionTables: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for sessions and login_attempts only
runtime.residual: Shared SQL credentials cannot enforce per-application-user password-row scope or posted-row immutability by these column grants alone; explicit owner disposition remains required.

maintenance: Separate temporary identity: SELECT plus approved-target CREATE/ALTER/INDEX/REFERENCES and only required initialization/catalog/user/role/session-revocation/audit/control/receipt writes. No DROP/TRUNCATE/reset or general application usage. Revoke after the approved operation.
backup: Separate reviewed source-only account with complete SELECT and required object-definition/trigger/routine/event metadata capabilities. Verify exact actual object coverage and restore permissions with provider; do not assume cPanel can grant the needed granularity.
